needed.evidence: Buildings open directly onto the road with no designated sidewalk.
needed.suggestion: Construct a purpose-built sidewalk on the right side to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: The road edge and informal path are uneven with debris and potholes.
needed.suggestion: Level and pave the informal path on the left side to remove trip hazards.

needed.evidence: Commercial buildings on both sides create crossing demand, but no designated facility exists.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing to provide a safe point for people to cross the road.
